parsed.doc_summary: Official text of Massachusetts G.L. c. 186, § 15B: caps upfront payments (first month, last month, security deposit equal to first month, lock and key) and sets security deposit handling, interest, receipt, return, and penalty rules.

rules.title: Massachusetts security deposit limits and handling (G.L. c. 186, § 15B)
rules.requirement: A landlord may not require a security deposit greater than the first month's rent. The deposit must be held in a separate interest-bearing Massachusetts bank account, with a receipt, a statement of condition, 5% annual interest (or the bank rate if lower), and return within 30 days after the tenancy ends, less itemized lawful deductions. Violations can cost the landlord the right to keep the deposit and expose them to treble damages.
rules.key_value: Security deposit capped at 1 month's rent; return within 30 days; 5% interest
rules.quoted_span: a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2)
rules.effective_date_note: Original effective date of the deposit cap is not stated in the document. The August 1, 2025 amendment (2025, 9) added agent language and an option for a fee in lieu of a deposit via regulations.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to leases or rentals of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.penalty: Landlord forfeits the right to retain any of the deposit; treble damages of the deposit plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees for certain violations.

unverifiable_exemptions: vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less

rules.coverage_conditions: Residential real property leases and tenancies.

rules.title: Massachusetts limit on upfront charges at lease start (G.L. c. 186, § 15B(1)(b))
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a landlord (or agent, from Aug 1, 2025) may require only first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of no more than one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. No other upfront payment may be required.
rules.key_value: Upfront charges limited to first month, last month, security deposit (max 1 month), and lock and key cost
rules.quoted_span: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:
rules.effective_date_note: Date the amendment extending the limit to agents took effect (2025, 9, Sec. 136). The underlying limit on landlords predates it; its original date is not stated in the document.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

unverifiable_exemptions: vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less
